sorry_locations: hg_entire: extending g across the finite set F via Riemann removable singularities
sorry_details.sorry_reason: The proof requires showing g_ext (defined as if z∈F then 0 else (f-w₀)⁻¹) is Differentiable ℂ. At z∉F, g_ext equals (f-w₀)⁻¹ near z since F is closed. At z∈F, the Riemann removable singularity theorem (Complex.analyticAt_of_differentiable_on_punctured_nhds_of_continuousAt) applies: g_ext is differentiable on a punctured neighborhood (from hg_diff) and continuous at z (from hg_poles). The sorry is at the interface between the if-then-else definition, the finite set structure, and Mathlib's analytic API — all mathematically routine but requiring careful filter/set bookkeeping.

proven_lemmas: hg_diff: g = (f-w₀)⁻¹ is differentiable on Fᶜ
hg_poles: ‖g‖ → 0 near each point of F
